+class AwaitableOrContextManagerWrapper(Generic[SupportsAsyncCloseType]):

+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raise_in_context", [False, True])
+async def test_request_form_context_manager_closes_files(raise_in_context: bool) -> None:
+    boundary = b"test-boundary"
+    body = b"".join(
+        [
+            b"--test-boundary\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; filename=\"first.txt\"\r\n",
+            b"Content-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nfirst\r\n",
+            b"--test-boundary\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; filename=\"second.txt\"\r\n",
+            b"Content-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nsecond\r\n",
+            b"--test-boundary--\r\n",
+        ]
+    )
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "http.request", "body": body}
+
+    request = Request(
+        {
+            "type": "http",
+            "method": "POST",
+            "path": "/",
+            "headers": [(b"content-type", b"multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary)],
+        },
+        receive,
+    )
+    files: list[BinaryIO] = []
+
+    try:
+        async with request.form() as form:
+            files = [value.file for _, value in form.multi_items() if isinstance(value, UploadFile)]
+            assert len(files) == 2
+            assert all(not file.closed for file in files)
+            if raise_in_context:
+                raise RuntimeError("context body failed")
+    except RuntimeError:
+        assert raise_in_context
+
+    assert all(file.closed for file in files)
+
+
